test_title: PYST 13: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The painting __look __good in this room.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'look' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject **'The painting'** is **singular** and therefore requires a singular verb.
 
• Therefore, the singular form of the verb 'looks' should be used in place of the plural form 'look'.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***The painting looks __good in this room*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When the subject of a sentence is singular, the verb must also be singular to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
 
• **Example:** *The cat **sits** on the mat*.
 
 
 
• When the subject of a sentence is plural, the verb must also be plural to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
 
• Example: *The cats **sit** on the mat*.
